questions.markdown:
A resistance of $7\Omega$ is connected in series with a pure inductance of $31.8\ \text{mH}$ and the circuit is connected to a $100\ \text{V}$, $50\ \text{Hz}$ sinusoidal supply. Calculate

i) circuit current  
ii) Phase angle  
iii) Power factor  
iv) Power.

Two circuits, the impedances of which are given by $Z_1=(15+j12)$ ohms and $Z_2=(8+j5)$ ohms are connected in parallel. If the potential difference across one of the impedances is $(250+j0)\ \text{V}$, calculate

(i) total current and branch currents  
(ii) total power and power consumed in each branch and  
(iii) overall power-factor

Two-wattmeter method is used to determine the input power to a three-phase motor. The readings of the meters are $5.2\ \text{kW}$ and $-1.7\ \text{kW}$, and the line voltage is $415\ \text{V}$. Calculate

(a) the total power,  
(b) the power factor, and  
(c) the line current.

A balanced star connected load of $(8+j6)\ \Omega$ per phase is connected to a $3\ \phi$, $230\ \text{Volts}$, $50\ \text{Hz}$, AC supply. Find

i) Line current  
ii) Power factor  
iii) Power  
iv) Total reactive Power  
v) Total Volt-Amp

An iron ring of cross-sectional area $6\ \text{cm}^2$ is wound with a wire of $100$ turns and has a saw cut of $2\ \text{mm}$. Calculate the magnetising current required to produce a flux of $0\cdot 1\ \text{mWb}$ if mean length of magnetic path is $30\ \text{cm}$ and relative permeability of iron is $470$.

A cast steel electromagnet has an air gap length of $3\ \text{mm}$ and an iron path of length $40\ \text{cm}$. Find the number of ampere-turns necessary to produce a flux density of $0.7\ \text{Wb}/\text{m}^2$ in the gap. Neglect leakage and fringing. Assume ampere-turns required for air gap to be $70\%$ of the total ampere-turns.
Explain the construction of single-phase induction motor.
Explain the working of single-phase digital energy meter with a neat diagram.
